title.narrative: Providing assistance to support the food security sector in the Republic of Madagascar

description.narrative: Main objective: Distributing food aid to the groups most affected by bad weather conditions and the resulting destruction of some agricultural crops and infrastructure. Sub-objectives: 1. Meeting the need of those affected by bad weather conditions for food supplies to rehabilitate agricultural crops. 2. Standing by the Malagasy people during crises and natural disasters that their country is exposed to.

Obtaining (43,052) food baskets of basic materials and distributing them to those affected by the most affected groups due to the bad weather conditions and the resulting destruction of some agricultural crops and infrastructure, with a total number of beneficiaries amounting to (220,260) beneficiaries.

Supporting the food security sector by providing (43,052) food baskets to vulnerable and affected groups in nine (9) regions in the Republic of Madagascar. Note that the geographical scope may change according to the humanitarian situation.
